newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Masfen family sells 24 mln CIL shares.
newsitem.headline: Masfen family sells 24 mln CIL shares.

text.p: Corporate Investments Ltd (CIL) said on Wednesday that chairman Peter Masfen's family interests had sold 24 million shares in CIL to an overseas institution.

"The sale of these shares represented an opportunity for Mr Masfen's family to diversify part of their investment portfolio and at the same time bring into the company's shareholding structure a well-known institution from overseas as a long term shareholder," CIL said in a statement.
It said Masfen's family interests would continue to hold a shareholding of approximately 21 percent in the company.
